title: HSK 3.6 · 父母, 幸福, 值得, 反对, 教练
focus: 各位 · 约 · 抓 · 光 · 父亲 · 金 · 社会 · 谈 · 至少 · 首先 · 父母 · 安排 · 敢 · 某 · 随 · 会议 · 幸福 · 赢 · 步 · 母亲 · 训练 · 过程 · 深 · 各 · 选手 · 值得 · 亲 · 反应 · 价值 · 值 · 速度 · 反对 · 程度 · 抓住 · 各种 · 对手 · 幸运 · 教练 · 资金 · 对象
body:
Family words (父亲, 母亲, 父母, 亲), sports words (训练, 教练, 选手, 对手) and a 值 "worth" family fill this lesson. 各 (each) and 对 (facing, opposite) each appear three times.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 各 | gè | each, every | 各位, 各, 各种 |
| 亲 | qīn | parent, close kin | 父亲, 母亲, 亲 |
| 对 | duì | facing, opposite | 反对, 对手, 对象 |
| 值 | zhí | worth (亻 + 直 zhí sound) | 值得, 价值, 值 |
| 父 / 母 | fù / mǔ | father / mother | 父亲, 父母, 母亲 |
| 反 | fǎn | reverse, against | 反应, 反对 |
| 幸 | xìng | fortunate | 幸福, 幸运 |
| 练 | liàn | practise (纟 silk) | 训练, 教练 |

## Watch out

- 幸 xìng (fortunate) vs 辛 xīn (bitter): 幸 has 土 on top.
- 步: the bottom is not 少, so don't add the extra dot.
- 教 is jiào in 教练 and 教室, but jiāo as a verb (教我).

cards.Example: 各位好！ gèwèi hǎo: hello everyone!
cards.Notes: 各 each + 位 (polite classifier for people) = each of you → everyone.

cards.Meaning: to make an appointment; about, approximately
cards.Example: 我约了朋友。 wǒ yuē le péngyou: I've made plans with a friend
cards.Notes: 纟 silk + 勺 sháo (sound hint) = tie up → agreement, date. 大约 about. 约会 a date.

cards.Example: 抓住我的手。 zhuāzhù wǒ de shǒu: grab my hand
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 爪 zhuǎ claw (also the sound) = grab.

cards.Example: 钱花光了。 qián huā guāng le: the money's all spent
cards.Notes: Fire on top of 儿 (a person) = light. After verbs: all used up (吃光了).

cards.Example: 我父亲是医生。 wǒ fùqīn shì yīshēng: my father is a doctor
cards.Notes: 父 father + 亲 parent, close kin = father. Formal version of 爸爸.

cards.Example: 这是金的吗？ zhè shì jīn de ma: is this gold?
cards.Notes: As a radical on the left it becomes 钅 metal: 钱 money, 银 silver, 铁 iron.

cards.Example: 社会变化很快。 shèhuì biànhuà hěn kuài: society is changing fast
cards.Notes: 社 community (礻 altar + 土 earth: the village earth-god altar) + 会 gather = society.

cards.Example: 我们谈谈吧。 wǒmen tántan ba: let's talk
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 炎 yán for the sound = talk. 谈恋爱 to date.

cards.Example: 至少要三天。 zhìshǎo yào sān tiān: it takes at least three days
cards.Notes: 至 to, utmost + 少 few = at the fewest → at least.

cards.Example: 首先，谢谢大家。 shǒuxiān, xièxie dàjiā: first of all, thank you all
cards.Notes: 首 head + 先 first = at the head → first of all.

cards.Example: 我父母都在北京。 wǒ fùmǔ dōu zài Běijīng: my parents are both in Beijing
cards.Notes: 父 father + 母 mother = parents.

cards.Example: 我来安排。 wǒ lái ānpái: I'll arrange it
cards.Notes: 安 settle + 排 line up (扌 hand + 非 fēi for the sound) = settle and line up → arrange.

cards.Example: 我不敢说。 wǒ bù gǎn shuō: I don't dare say
cards.Notes: Left part + 攵 (a hand holding a stick, "action") = to dare. 不敢 = not dare.

cards.Example: 某个人告诉我的。 mǒu ge rén gàosu wǒ de: someone told me
cards.Notes: 甘 sweet + 木 tree. Also the sound part of 谋 móu, 媒 méi, 煤 méi.

cards.Example: 随你。 suí nǐ: up to you
cards.Notes: 阝 + 有 + 辶 walk = follow. 随便 whatever, 随时 any time.

cards.Example: 会议几点开始？ huìyì jǐ diǎn kāishǐ: when does the meeting start?
cards.Notes: 会 meet + 议 discuss = meet to discuss → meeting.

cards.Example: 祝你们幸福！ zhù nǐmen xìngfú: wishing you happiness!
cards.Notes: 幸 fortunate + 福 blessing (礻 altar) = blessed → happy. 幸 xìng vs 辛 xīn bitter.

cards.Example: 我们赢了！ wǒmen yíng le: we won!
cards.Notes: Packed with parts: 亡 口 月 贝 凡; 贝 (money) hints at gain. Opposite: 输 shū lose.

cards.Example: 一步一步来。 yí bù yí bù lái: one step at a time
cards.Notes: 止 foot on top + another foot below = two feet → step. The bottom is not 少: no extra dot.

cards.Example: 母亲节快乐！ Mǔqīn jié kuàilè: happy Mother's Day!
cards.Notes: 母 mother (woman with two dots) + 亲 parent = mother. Formal version of 妈妈.

cards.Example: 他每天训练。 tā měitiān xùnliàn: he trains every day
cards.Notes: 训 instruct (讠 speech + 川 chuān for the sound) + 练 practise (纟) = drill, train.

cards.Example: 过程很重要。 guòchéng hěn zhòngyào: the process matters
cards.Notes: 过 pass + 程 journey, procedure (禾 + 呈 chéng for the sound) = the road you pass along → process.

cards.Example: 这条河很深。 zhè tiáo hé hěn shēn: this river is deep
cards.Notes: 氵 water + right part (sound) = deep water. Colours: 深蓝 dark blue.

cards.Example: 各人有各人的想法。 gè rén yǒu gè rén de xiǎngfǎ: everyone has their own ideas
cards.Notes: 夂 + 口. The sound part in 格, 客, 路, 落.

cards.Example: 他是最好的选手。 tā shì zuì hǎo de xuǎnshǒu: he's the best player
cards.Notes: 选 choose + 手 hand, skilled person = chosen hand → contestant.

cards.Example: 这本书值得看。 zhè běn shū zhíde kàn: this book is worth reading
cards.Notes: 值 worth + 得 get = worth getting → worthwhile.

cards.Example: 亲一下。 qīn yíxià: give me a kiss
cards.Notes: 立 + 木; the traditional 親 adds 见 see. 亲人 family, 亲自 in person.

cards.Example: 他反应很快。 tā fǎnyìng hěn kuài: he reacts quickly
cards.Notes: 反 back + 应 yìng respond = respond back → react. 应 is yīng in 应该.

cards.Example: 这有什么价值？ zhè yǒu shénme jiàzhí: what's the value of this?
cards.Notes: 价 price + 值 worth = value.

cards.Example: 这个值多少钱？ zhège zhí duōshao qián: how much is this worth?
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 直 zhí for the sound = worth.

cards.Example: 速度太快了。 sùdù tài kuài le: it's way too fast
cards.Notes: 速 fast (辶 + 束 shù for the sound) + 度 degree, measure = speed.

cards.Example: 我反对。 wǒ fǎnduì: I object
cards.Notes: 反 against + 对 face = face against → oppose.

cards.Example: 你的中文到什么程度？ nǐ de Zhōngwén dào shénme chéngdù: how good is your Chinese?
cards.Notes: 程 measure, rule + 度 degree = extent.

cards.Example: 抓住机会！ zhuāzhù jīhuì: seize the chance!
cards.Notes: 抓 grab + 住 hold firm (result) = grab and hold on.

cards.Example: 这里有各种水果。 zhèlǐ yǒu gè zhǒng shuǐguǒ: there's all kinds of fruit here
cards.Notes: 各 each + 种 kind = every kind.

cards.Example: 他是我的对手。 tā shì wǒ de duìshǒu: he's my rival
cards.Notes: 对 opposite + 手 hand, player = the player opposite → opponent.

cards.Example: 你真幸运！ nǐ zhēn xìngyùn: you're so lucky!
cards.Notes: 幸 fortunate + 运 luck, move (辶 + 云 yún for the sound) = good luck.

cards.Example: 他是我的教练。 tā shì wǒ de jiàoliàn: he's my coach
cards.Notes: 教 jiào teach + 练 practise = one who drills you → coach. 教 is jiāo as a plain verb.

cards.Example: 我们没有资金。 wǒmen méiyǒu zījīn: we have no funding
cards.Notes: 资 resources (贝 money + 次 cì for the sound) + 金 money = funds.

cards.Example: 你有对象吗？ nǐ yǒu duìxiàng ma: are you seeing anyone?
cards.Notes: 对 facing + 象 image = the one you face → target, object; colloquially a partner.
